feed_urls.title: Blocklist Feed URLs
feed_urls.description: List of URLs to fetch malicious extension ID lists from. Each URL should return one extension ID per line.

custom_blocklist.title: Admin Blocklist
custom_blocklist.description: Extension IDs to block, managed by the admin. Users cannot override these.

whitelist.title: Admin Whitelist
whitelist.description: Extension IDs to always allow, even if they appear in a feed. Overrides all blocklists.

auto_disable.title: Auto-Disable Threats
auto_disable.description: Automatically disable detected malicious extensions without waiting for user action.

check_interval_minutes.title: Feed Check Interval (minutes)
check_interval_minutes.description: How often to re-fetch the blocklist feeds.

warn_interval_minutes.title: Warning Repeat Interval (minutes)
warn_interval_minutes.description: How often to re-show warnings for unresolved threats.

lock_settings.title: Lock User Settings
lock_settings.description: If true, users cannot change auto-disable, intervals, or whitelist. Admin policy takes full control.

adblock_enabled.title: Ad Blocker Enabled
adblock_enabled.description: Enable or disable built-in ad blocking rule enforcement.

adblock_rules.title: Ad Block Rules
adblock_rules.description: Additional ad block URL patterns or domains to block. Use hostnames like example.com or adblock-style filters.

org_name.title: Organization Name
org_name.description: Displayed in the UI to indicate the extension is managed.

org_message.title: Custom Warning Message
org_message.description: Additional message shown on the warning page, e.g. 'Contact IT at helpdesk@company.com'.
